sections_target.text: Introduction

This 
document sets out 
the technical inspection checklist 
for the steam turbine, 
denoted by the code I1, 
which 
is carried out every year, 
denoted by the code Y1, 
in accordance with 
the manufacturer's instructions and acquired experience, in order to provide safety factors for personnel and to maintain 
the safe operation of the equipment.

Safety 
 precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority

sections_target.text:
Tools, 
equipment and instruments used
Helmet, shoes and safety belt

Steps of 
the work to be carried out
Cool the unit and stop the slow turning

Inspect
the turbine bearing pedestal 
HB No. 01

Inspect turbine bearing pedestal HB 
No. 2

Inspect turbine bearing pedestal LP 
No. 3
Inspect turbine bearing pedestal LP No. 4
Inspect the generator bearing pedestals Nos. 5 and 6

Inspect the 
generator air coolers and their cleanliness

Inspect the 
 boiler bypass valve No. A 
and repair it if necessary

Clean the 
condenser cooling-water box and fit valve leakage prevention if 
necessary
Inspect the condenser cooling pipes and remedy any leaks
Inspect the oil-vapour extraction fan and repair it if necessary
Repack the steam valves.
Transfer the oil from the unit tank to the storage tank.
Carry out FLUSHING of the oil lines.
Put the turbine on slow turning
